title: PEIS Legacy Report DataSet Shape Fixture
description: Sanitized contract for asserting returned DataSet table and column shapes. Do not include row values, patient identifiers, SQL, FRX, connection strings, or credentials.

name.description: Exact DataTable name returned by the approved legacy report query.

minimumRows.description: Minimum acceptable row count; use zero when only shape is deterministic.

columns.description: Column names only. Never include values or inferred patient data.

columnTypes.description: Optional column-name to CLR type mapping, such as System.String. Never include values or inferred patient data.
